WITH per_account AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
                WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
            END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE amount >= 2400
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_across_accounts_signed_amount,
    AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_across_accounts_balance
FROM per_account;
